Fact Check on Alleged Attack on Political Party Founder

A fact-check inquiry has arisen regarding an alleged attack on Abhijit Dipke, the founder of the Cockroach Janata Party, in Mumbai. Social media messages have circulated, claiming Dipke was targeted. Javed Akhtar has reportedly reacted strongly to messages mentioning the Cockroach Janata Party and Abhijit Dipke.
